compositional_frameworks.environment_assumptions: All linked modules are compiled by the exact same CompCert pass pipeline (`nlist_forall2`); public symbol declarations (`prog_public`) match across units
compositional_frameworks.unverified_code_support: Only via external axioms (`extcall_sem`); cannot link hand-written assembly into the C call graph without CompCertO/CompCertM
compositional_frameworks.callbacks_and_reentrancy: Full mutual recursion among CompCert-compiled C units after syntactic linking

compositional_frameworks.mechanism: Per-unit pass relation `match_prog` allowing optimization passes to be disabled on individual units (`TransfIfLink`)
compositional_frameworks.environment_assumptions: All modules share CompCert's closed-world `Genv` and memory model at the target/intermediate language boundary
compositional_frameworks.unverified_code_support: Supports linking with CompCert-compatible target modules that satisfy the pass-boundary simulation
compositional_frameworks.callbacks_and_reentrancy: Full mutual recursion across linked units

compositional_frameworks.mechanism: Interaction semantics (`AtExternal`/`AfterExternal` cores) + structured memory injections with rely-guarantee permission protocols
compositional_frameworks.environment_assumptions: Environment transitions obey structured memory-injection growth and do not overwrite caller-private blocks
compositional_frameworks.unverified_code_support: Links arbitrary CompCert-memory-compatible languages (including VST-verified C and hand-verified assembly)
compositional_frameworks.callbacks_and_reentrancy: Full reentrant callbacks via structured memory-injection composition

compositional_frameworks.mechanism: Refinement Under Self-related Contexts (RUSC) + mixed C/Assembly operational semantics
compositional_frameworks.environment_assumptions: Context modules are self-related under the finite set of RUSC Kripke memory relations
compositional_frameworks.unverified_code_support: Links C modules with hand-verified assembly modules that preserve callee-saved registers and private stack slots
compositional_frameworks.callbacks_and_reentrancy: Supports arbitrary mutual recursion and callbacks between C and Assembly

compositional_frameworks.mechanism: Open simulations parameterized by Kripke simulation conventions (`callconv liA liB`: `ro @ c_injp @ wt_c @ ca_injp`)
compositional_frameworks.environment_assumptions: Environment calls and replies satisfy the Kripke world invariants (`injp`, read-only globals `ro`, ABI typing `wt_c`) at query/reply boundaries
compositional_frameworks.unverified_code_support: Composes with any foreign/assembly module proved or assumed to refine its open `callconv` specification
compositional_frameworks.callbacks_and_reentrancy: Full horizontal and vertical composition with reentrant callbacks

compositional_frameworks.mechanism: Unifies conditional CompCert-style contextual refinement with Iris separation-logic Hoare triples and ghost PCM resources
compositional_frameworks.environment_assumptions: Unverified/external functions satisfy their separation-logic Hoare specifications (`cond_refines`) at every invocation
compositional_frameworks.unverified_code_support: First-class conditional theorems: if imported functions satisfy their Iris/relational specs, exported functions refine their abstract models
compositional_frameworks.callbacks_and_reentrancy: Supports reentrancy when ghost invariants are restored before issuing external calls

compositional_frameworks.mechanism: Angelic/demonic event-stream module transitions (`ModTrans`) without a shared global memory model
compositional_frameworks.environment_assumptions: Connected modules agree on the syntactic/semantic event wrapper (`Vis` events) and satisfy angelic/demonic precondition filters
compositional_frameworks.unverified_code_support: Links truly heterogeneous languages (high-level expression languages, C-like heaps, flat assembly) via event adapters
compositional_frameworks.callbacks_and_reentrancy: Arbitrary reentrant cross-language calls and callbacks

compositional_frameworks.framework: Robust / Secure Compilation (TOPLAS 2019 DOI 10.1145/3280984; CSF 2019 DOI 10.1109/CSF.2019.00025)
compositional_frameworks.mechanism: Robust Trace Property Preservation (`RTP` / `RSC`) via dynamic boundary checks, SFI/Wasm sandboxing, or CHERI capabilities
compositional_frameworks.environment_assumptions: Adversarial unverified context has NO functional contract, but is confined by a hardware/software isolation boundary
compositional_frameworks.unverified_code_support: Protects verified module invariants even against actively malicious unverified contexts via dynamic capability/bounds checks
compositional_frameworks.callbacks_and_reentrancy: Requires dynamic reentrancy guards or defensive invariant checks upon callback entry/return

whole_program_optimizations.closed_world_premise: Symbol `s` is not in `GUIDPreservedSymbols` (exported roots, `#[no_mangle]`, `#[used]`, weak lang items, `RUSTC_STD_INTERNAL_SYMBOL`) and is not referenced from outside its CGU (`ExportLists`)
whole_program_optimizations.separate_compilation_hazard: Internalizing a symbol referenced by a late-linked allocator shim (`__rg_alloc`) or naked asm block causes unresolved symbol errors (`rustc #60184`, `ImportEnabled = false` at `PassWrapper.cpp:1314`)

whole_program_optimizations.closed_world_premise: Every live entry point is reachable in the reference graph starting from `prog_public` / `GUIDPreservedSymbols`
whole_program_optimizations.compcert_or_llvm_precedent: CompCert `backend/Unusedglob.v` (`used_globals` worklist closure; `TransfUnusedglobLink` requires `prog_public p1 = prog_public p2`)
whole_program_optimizations.separate_compilation_hazard: Deleting a private helper or static that is reached via an unrecorded cross-unit relocation or linker-injected symbol

whole_program_optimizations.closed_world_premise: Target function `f` has `Linkage::Internal` (so all call sites are visible inside the module) or is cloned into a specialized internal copy while keeping the external entry point intact
whole_program_optimizations.separate_compilation_hazard: Specializing an externally visible function body in-place causes UB/wrong results when an external caller passes a non-constant argument (`canary_open_world_ipsccp_unsound`)

whole_program_optimizations.closed_world_premise: Function has local (`Internal` / `Private`) linkage and its address is never taken (`hasLocalLinkage() && !F.hasAddressTaken()`)
whole_program_optimizations.separate_compilation_hazard: Altering the ABI signature of an address-taken or externally callable function mismatches caller/callee register assignments

whole_program_optimizations.closed_world_premise: Every vtable implementing the trait/type metadata (`!type`) has internal/hidden LTO visibility so the complete set of virtual targets is known at link time
whole_program_optimizations.separate_compilation_hazard: Dynamic loading (`dlopen`) or FFI constructing a vtable outside the LTO unit violates the closed vtable set

whole_program_optimizations.closed_world_premise: One-Definition / Symbol Coherence Premise (`WeakOdrCoherent`): every `LinkOnceODR`/`WeakODR` copy and `available_externally` summary body for the same mangled symbol `GUID` refines the same contract
whole_program_optimizations.separate_compilation_hazard: If two CGUs/crates emit semantically distinct bodies under the same mangled symbol (`canary_incoherent_weak_odr_unsound`), inlining the `available_externally` copy disagrees with the linker's prevailing copy
